title: Evaluate an observation-only twelve-frame policy shield
doing: Propose frozen420 with and without a12-raw-frame collision mask on all nine logits at K1/K4, sampled and argmax separately, on the consumed2048-seed telemetry cohort. Shield consumes only teacher allowlisted arrays and public physics constants; no native RNG, true-future step or hidden metadata. Require the observability audit, all-safe parity, empty-mask fallback, source/resource gates and explicit go-ahead.
expected: A useful observed-motion mask may reduce early contact deaths and improve Q1, but extrapolation error or over-conservative vetoes may reduce survival or score. Any gain supports this model-based intervention, not proof that the network lacks planning; no safety guarantee or stronger-teacher adoption follows automatically.

evidence.label: Priority reconciliation, observation-only shield and long-run gate
